title: 航空渦扇引擎剖面解讀
summary: 以「沿風扇、核心與軸系讀懂渦扇能量動量流」為主線，在非運轉渦扇剖面與控制體教學台中依序完成旁通比與總流量邊界、核心壓縮理想溫比、燃料能量與有用輸出、葉尖速度與幾何尺度、不同工況的性能殘差及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Read turbofan energy and momentum flow through fan, core and shafts in a Non-operating turbofan sections and control-volume bench, progressing through Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary, Ideal core-compression temperature ratio, Fuel energy and useful output, Tip speed and geometric scale, Performance residuals across conditions, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 旁通比與總流量邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 旁通比與總流量邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空渦扇引擎剖面解讀」中，本單元處理「旁通比與總流量邊界」。旁通比是旁通流量除核心流量，不是旁通流占總流的百分比。
steps.instructionEn: Within Turbofan engine cross-section interpretation, this unit examines Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary. Bypass ratio is bypass divided by core flow, not bypass percentage of total flow.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：旁通流 mb=80 kg/s、核心 mc=10 kg/s。關係式 BPR=mb/mc；含輸出單位換算的算式 80/10，結果 8 ratio。適用範圍：定義練習；未據此推算效率、噪音或特定機型性能。
steps.observationEn: This unit uses an independent hypothetical bench; dimensions and loads must not be combined with other units without reconciliation. Original teaching assumptions, not aircraft measurements or operating settings: Bypass flow mb=80 kg/s and core flow mc=10 kg/s. Relation BPR=mb/mc; evaluated expression including output-unit conversion 80/10 gives 8 ratio. Applicability: Definition exercise; efficiency, noise and aircraft performance are not inferred.
steps.failure: 在「旁通比與總流量邊界」的情境中，流量計位置不同若包含抽氣，兩個數可能不在同一守恆邊界。
steps.failureEn: In the context of Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary, Measurements that include different bleed flows may violate a common balance boundary.
steps.check: 針對「旁通比與總流量邊界」，分別算旁通比與旁通占總流分率，確認兩者不同。 保留單位、條件及原始計算，並以另一種可能原因作對照。
steps.checkEn: For Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary, Calculate both bypass ratio and bypass fraction of total flow and compare. Retain units, conditions and raw calculations, and compare one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只把 mc 改為16 kg/s，其餘條件固定。用 80/16 重算，結果從 8 變成 5 ratio。先預測方向，再記下對「旁通比與總流量邊界」的意義與一項不能外推的結論。只在離線模型或紙上完成。
knowledge.textEn: Change only mc to 16 kg/s, holding all other conditions fixed. Recalculate 80/16: 8 becomes 5 ratio. Predict the direction, explain its meaning for Bypass ratio and total-flow boundary, and state one conclusion that cannot be extrapolated. Work only in offline models or on paper.

steps.title: 入口出口動量控制體：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Inlet-exit momentum control volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 入口出口動量控制體 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Inlet-exit momentum control volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「航空渦扇引擎剖面解讀」中，本單元處理「入口出口動量控制體」。同一控制體內，出口與入口動量通量差加壓力項構成推力；忽略入口會得到錯誤淨值。
steps.instructionEn: Within Turbofan engine cross-section interpretation, this unit examines Inlet-exit momentum control volume. Net thrust combines exit-minus-inlet momentum flux and pressure thrust; omitting the inlet gives the wrong net value.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想台架，與其他單元尺寸及負載不可直接拼接。原創教學假設，非機型實測或操作值：質量流率 ṁ=5 kg/s、出口 ve=300 m/s、入口 v0=50 m/s；壓力項取零。關係式 F=ṁ(ve-v0)；含輸出單位換算的算式 5*(300-50)，結果 1250 N。適用範圍：等質量流近似，燃料質量與壓力推力忽略；非特定引擎數據。
